title: GET /api/box/universe (200)
description: Every underlying the engine could watch, for the PRE-RUN picker. Source: src/box/engine.ts listUniverse(), projected by src/box/universeView.ts. TOP LEVEL IS CLOSED. Available while the engine is still IDLE, which is the whole point: boot() performs one universe pass, so an operator can decide what to discover instead of inferring it afterwards from whichever opportunities happened to appear. Reading it is cheap and side-effect free — board and chains are already in memory and nothing is fetched. Carries no secret: instrument metadata, the operator's own blocklist notes and two quantity caps, never a token, account, position or price.

underlyings.description: Indices first, then alphabetical — deliberately the same order prioritiseUniverse applies when the token budget binds, so the list an operator reads is the order the engine will actually select in. A picker sorted differently from the selector would quietly mislead about which names survive a budget squeeze.

summary.description: Headline counts, so a client need not re-derive them and cannot derive them differently.

indices.description: How many of those are indices rather than single stocks.

excluded.description: On the operator blocklist. Counted regardless of admissibility.

watchable.description: Not excluded AND admissible — what discovery will actually consider. This is the number to sanity-check before arming; the token budget may still narrow it further at run time (see skipped_for_budget in box-status).

blocked_by_caps.description: NOT excluded but inadmissible under the current quantity caps. The count that matters most: these names look enabled and can never trade. Excluded names are omitted from it deliberately — a name the operator already declined is not a configuration problem they need told about.

caps.description: The quantity caps every row was judged against, echoed so a client can explain a verdict without reading configuration it has no access to. 0 means no limit.

max_open_leg_quantity.description: BOX_LIVE_MAX_OPEN_LEG_QUANTITY — units permitted on a single order leg. ONE global number against F&O lot sizes that span orders of magnitude, which is why per-row admissibility has to be computed at all.

max_gross_open_leg_quantity.description: BOX_LIVE_MAX_GROSS_OPEN_LEG_QUANTITY — units permitted across all open legs. A box needs four legs of one lot, so this binds at a quarter of its face value per box.

built.description: Whether a universe pass has produced a board yet. False with an empty `underlyings` means DISCOVERY HAS NOT RUN, not that the universe is empty — without this field an empty list at boot reads as a broken instrument master.

built_at.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last universe pass, or null when none has completed. Same clock as universe_built_at in box-status.

blocklist_readable.description: Mirrors `readable` from box-excluded-underlyings. False REFUSES all new entry (readiness blocker underlying_exclusions_unreadable), so a picker must say so rather than presenting a universe that looks armable — every row would be refused regardless of what it shows.
